name: One S

images.credit: AnVuong1222004 (2), CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Body.Dimensions: 130.9 mm H, 65 mm W, 7.8 mm D

Platform.Operating system: Android 4.0.3 Ice Cream Sandwich, HTC Sense 4.1 overlay, upgradeable to Android 4.1.1 Jelly Bean and HTC Sense UI 4+ (Update to Sense 5 discontinued)
Platform.Chipset: Qualcomm Snapdragon S4 Plus MSM8960 for Z520e variant and Qualcomm Snapdragon S3 MSM8260 for Z560e variant
Platform.CPU: 1.5 GHz Dual-core Qualcomm Krait for Z520e variant or 1.7 GHz Dual-core Qualcomm Scorpion for Z560e variant
Platform.GPU: Adreno 225 for Z520e variant or Adreno 220 for Z560e variant

Display.Display: 4.3 in Super AMOLED with RGBG-matrix (PenTile), qHD (540×960) resolution, covered with Gorilla glass

Cameras.Rear camera: 8-megapixel (3,264×2,448) with autofocus, smart LED flash, BSI sensor, 1080p HD video recording

Connectivity.Connectivity: 3.5 mm stereo audio jack, Bluetooth 4.0 with aptX enabled, Wi-Fi: IEEE 802.11b/g/n, DLNA, micro-USB 2.0 (5-pin) port with mobile high-definition video link (MHL) for USB or HDMI connection

key.chipset: Qualcomm Snapdragon S4 Plus MSM8960 for Z520e variant
